current_core_warning: The pilot artifacts are valid only for their content-addressed ce8d2b snapshot; the live source changed afterward and remains uncertified.
findings: All four matched cells completed with stable source hashes and near-zero supply residuals.
Every cell had zero latent contact events and zero adjacent activations in the original ce8d2b snapshot runs.
The same zero-contact/zero-adjacent-activation pattern recurred on the current c2afb8 snapshot pilot.
Symmetric stationary-formation memory changed the memory stock but not the short-horizon renewal diagnostic.
Geographic-neighbor restriction changed 7-day and 28-day renewal and final Moran's I in the 42-day extension.
The observed neighbor-restriction contrast is not interpretable as causal geographic reproduction because the activation pathway was never exercised.
interpretation: The preregistered factorial is operationally reproducible, and its design limitation survives a current-snapshot check: memory is exercised but contact and adjacent activation are not. This is a design failure, not evidence for or against competitive local reproduction.
next_preregistered_design_requirements: Add a fixed synthetic challenge initial condition with at least one government-insurgent co-location and a declared contact-opportunity rate.
Require nonzero latent contacts and at least one post-initial activation before interpreting memory or adjacency effects.
Keep the challenge separate from historical fitting and from any core-change decision.
Run the existing truth-recovery battery and the matched-seed factorial after the challenge contract is frozen.
Retain the current null result as a bounded design diagnostic; do not pool it with future challenge runs.
